envelope.description: Apply atomic immutable coverage and finding deltas

body.title: Apply atomic immutable coverage and finding deltas
body.summary: Implement ledger.ts pure apply/validate operations: admit evidence/findings then row assessments, resolve all references and validate the complete candidate before returning a frozen new value.
acceptanceChecks: review-s2-ac2: evidence can support many independently assessed rows; note-only/uninspected/partial/unavailable evidence cannot silently satisfy coverage.
Non-pending assessments require rationale/authenticated attempt; findings have criterion/severity/confidence and evidence/expectation links; pending never implies completion.
review-s2-ac3: required rows and findings never disappear; row updates preserve linked history; unknown/foreign/dangling references and dropped rows reject atomically.
Identical replay stable; conflicting IDs reject; discovered impact rows append through trusted catalog; no durable fencing/persistence or terminal approval logic.
Focused adversarial atomicity, replay, mutation and retention tests pass.

tests.name: review-s2-ac2/ac3 atomic many-to-many coverage and history retention
